Tracker descriptions in your language.

### What's new
- **Automatic translation**: era descriptions and track notes are translated into the app language as you open them. Tap the translate icon at the end of the text to see the original, and tap it again to go back to the translation.
- Translation runs on your phone: the first time, the app downloads the language (about 30 MB), then it works offline too. Translations are saved, so they open instantly the next time.
- You can turn it off in **Settings → Language**.

### Installation
Update from **Settings → Updates** in the app, or download **ArtistGrid.apk** below. Installs over the previous version and keeps your favorites. Requires Android 6.0+.

> Debug build, not signed for the Play Store.
